content.text: In regions where platforms like Stripe are unavailable, digital creators face significant obstacles in [[LINK:https://[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-honest-side-side-11|COREMERCH guide to coremerch]].github.io/store/blog/how-setting-up-now[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-infrastructure-south-asian-creators-explained-digital-creators-2|Payment Infrastructure]]s-digital-store-works-how-18|setting]] up their online stores. This guide walks you through leveraging Supabase as the order database, offering a robust infrastructure solution for accepting crypto payments without depending on traditional payment processors. You will learn to deploy Stack 01, which can be operational within 4 to 6 hours, providing you with the tools necessary to launch your store successfully.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The failure of conventional payment platforms in various countries creates a pressing need for reliable infrastructure alternatives. COREMERCH addresses this gap by offering a comprehensive suite of tools that empower digital creators to establish their online shops independently. By combining free and open-source technologies, such as GitHub Pages and Supabase, you can circumvent the barriers imposed by traditional financial systems and maintain full control over your sales process. This approach ensures sovereignty over your digital commerce operations, allowing you to focus on what you do best: creating.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your online store with Stack 01, ensure you have the necessary accounts and resources set up. Create a GitHub account for hosting your website, and familiarize yourself with Google Apps Script for automating backend processes. Additionally, sign up for NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions effortlessly. Prepare your product files and descriptions, and structure your database schema in Supabase for order management. This groundwork is essential for a smooth deployment, ensuring that all components work harmoniously from the outset.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Start by configuring your GitHub Pages site to host your store. Implement Google Apps Script to manage the backend logic, where you will handle order processing and payment verification. Integrate NOWPayments to facilitate on-chain crypto transactions with minimal fees. The seamless nature of this setup allows for automatic delivery of digital products upon successful payment confirmation. Make sure to test each element in isolation to confirm functionality before going live, ensuring that your payment pipeline works flawlessly.
Empower your digital commerce with infrastructure you own.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once everything is set up, it’s time to launch your store. Begin by pushing your code to GitHub Pages, making your store accessible to customers. Monitor the backend through Google Apps Script, ensuring that all order requests are processed correctly. To process your first transaction, simulate a purchase using a small amount of cryptocurrency. This will not only test your payment integration but also allow you to confirm that the delivery pipeline functions as intended, providing customers with instant access to their purchased products.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully launching your store, focus on scaling operations. With Stack 01, you can easily add more products and enhance your database structure in Supabase to accommodate increased order volume. Consider implementing marketing strategies to reach a broader audience and drive traffic to your store. Continuous monitoring of performance metrics will help you identify areas to optimize, ensuring that your digital commerce infrastructure remains efficient and responsive to customer needs.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, utilize tools like GitHub Pages for hosting, Google Apps Script for backend processing, and NOWPayments for transaction management. This combination allows you to circumvent traditional payment barriers and maintain full control over your sales process, making it a viable solution for creators in restricted regions.
No subscriptions, no dependencies, just pure sovereignty.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators at the store setup stage comparing Stack 01 and Stack 02 are typically choosing between building it themselves with the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 — which covers both stacks in complete detail with full source code — or having COREMERCH deploy the complete Edge Stack under their accounts with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Both result in the same ownership structure: your GitHub or Cloudflare account, your Supabase database, your NOWPayments account, your wallet, your store. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Follow the setup sequence without skipping steps — configuration errors are significantly harder to diagnose than setup time. First: create your NOWPayments account, add wallet addresses, generate your API key, and note your IPN secret key. Second: deploy the backend — configure Cloudflare Worker with your NOWPayments credentials and product settings, or configure Google Apps Script with the same — and confirm the endpoint URL. Third: set the webhook endpoint URL in your NOWPayments IPN settings. Fourth: deploy the storefront to Cloudflare Pages or GitHub Pages and confirm product pages and checkout display correctly. Fifth: configure your custom domain and DNS if using one. Sixth: complete a real mainnet test transaction. Seventh: check the order database for the test entry. Only after steps six and seven pass cleanly should you share the store URL publicly.
Frequently Asked Questions
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build your digital store, use GitHub Pages for hosting and integrate Google Apps Script for backend functionality. Pair this with NOWPayments to handle crypto transactions without fees. This setup allows you to own your infrastructure and operate without reliance on traditional payment platforms.
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages and Google Apps Script, allowing deployment in 4-6 hours. Stack 02, known as the Edge Commerce Stack, utilizes Cloudflare Pages and Workers, enabling a more robust setup with advanced features, deployed within 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?

Yes, both GitHub Pages and Cloudflare Pages are suitable for hosting your digital product store. GitHub Pages is ideal for simpler setups, while Cloudflare Pages offers enhanced performance and scalability for larger operations.
What types of products can I sell using this infrastructure?

You can sell a wide range of digital products, including ebooks, courses, templates, and software. The infrastructure is designed to handle various digital goods seamlessly, allowing you to focus on creating and marketing your products.
How does NOWPayments work with my digital store?

NOWPayments simplifies the payment process by allowing you to accept over 300 cryptocurrencies. It integrates easily with your backend to provide automatic payment verification, ensuring that transactions are processed efficiently and securely.
